'''2017 EGP Matt Thornton LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Thornton]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HB Thornton LS 2017 EGP 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Username:''' BroDerlin
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
